calculation.description: Reverse each asset's five-day return relative to the cross-sectional median, with continuously scaled activation as the fraction of tradable assets having negative five-day returns rises above 50%. Uses only information available through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.1057959; 187 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.0648465; 123 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.0141805; 82 dates), though recent effectiveness weakened. Five-day IC +0.0766466 over 143 dates; ten-day IC +0.0444086 over 252 dates. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
